decisions.reason: Its dedicated 2024 page and close fit with established identity services signal visible commitment and sunk costs that management will seek to justify, making withdrawal unlikely.

Although it lacks a dedicated page, the multi-model open framework is central to the firm's extensible components and has accumulated development costs, so the firm is likely to persist rather than abandon it.

The product has a dedicated page and a specific launch statement, reflecting strong public commitment and close alignment with established GIS identity solutions, so escalation pressures support keeping it.

As a newly launched workshop with its own page, any disappointing early results can still be attributed to temporary factors, and the recent investment and public commitment discourage immediate withdrawal.
